data.name: Shidharth
data.long_meaning: The name Shidharth is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shidhartha', which means 'prosperous' or 'successful'. In Hindu mythology, Shidharth is believed to be the name of a king who ruled over the Vidarbha region in ancient India. He is also known as the 'King of Hastinapura' and is a central character in the epic Mahabharata.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Shidharth signifies the attainment of worldly success and material prosperity, as well as the inner wisdom and spiritual growth that comes with it.

historical_references.reference: Shuddhodana, the king of the Sakya clan in Magadha, had a son named Siddhartha, later known as Gautama Buddha. He was born in Lumbini, Nepal, around 563 BCE and is considered the founder of Buddhism.

Another Siddhartha is mentioned in Hindu scriptures as a sage and disciple of Krishna. He is said to have renounced his kingdom and wealth to seek enlightenment under Krishna's guidance around 3100 BCE.
